mapper.select: SELECT NVL(F.FUNDACCT, ' ') AS FUNDACCT, C.CUSTNO, U.CUSTNAME AS INVNM, U.IDTYPE AS IDTP, U.IDNO, U.MOBILE, C.OPENDT FROM CUSTINFO C, FUNDACCOINFO F, USER_BASEINFO U, USER_ACCORLA A WHERE C.CUSTNO = F.CUSTNO(+) AND U.CMFUSERID = A.CMFUSERID AND A.ECCUSTNO = C.CUSTNO ORDER BY C.OPENDT DESC
